<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Collar of Inconspicuousness](/Equipment.aspx?ID=405)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Companion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=29" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 604 <sup>4.0</sup>

**Price** 475 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn collar

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This leather collar’s worn and almost threadbare look belies its magical nature. When your companion wears and invests the collar, it gains the ability to change its appearance from that of a ferocious animal into a more inconspicuous form.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** You touch your animal companion to transform it into a nonthreatening Tiny creature of the same family or a similar creature (for instance, a house cat instead of a tiger, or a puppy instead of a wolf). This has the effects of [_pest form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=217) (2nd level, or 4th level if your companion can fly). The effect lasts until you Dismiss it.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
